record.original_question: Let X_3 be a smooth cubic hypersurface in P^4, let S_3 be a smooth hyperplane section, and put V_3 = X_3 \ S_3, viewed as an affine cubic hypersurface in C^4. Is every automorphism of V_3 induced by an automorphism of the pair (X_3, S_3)? Equivalently, is Aut(V_3) = Aut(X_3, S_3), and in particular is Aut(V_3) finite?

evidence.quote: Problem 7 (Adrien Dubouloz) Let X3 be a smooth cubic hypersurface in P4, and let S3 be a smooth hyperplane section. Put V3 = X3\S3, so that V3 is an affine cubic hypersurface in C4. ... Is it true that Aut(V3) = Aut(X3, S3) so that, in particular, Aut(V3) is finite?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X_3 \subset \mathbb{P}^4_{\mathbb{C}}$ be a smooth cubic hypersurface, and let $S_3 = X_3 \cap H$ be a smooth hyperplane section, where $H \subset \mathbb{P}^4$ is a hyperplane. Set
$$V_3 = X_3 \setminus S_3,$$
which is a smooth affine cubic hypersurface in $\mathbb{A}^4_{\mathbb{C}} = \mathbb{P}^4 \setminus H$. Let $\mathrm{Aut}(V_3)$ denote the group of algebraic automorphisms of the affine variety $V_3$, and let $\mathrm{Aut}(X_3, S_3)$ denote the group of automorphisms of $X_3$ preserving $S_3$ (equivalently, automorphisms of the pair $(X_3, S_3)$), which act naturally on $V_3$ by restriction.

Question: Is every automorphism of $V_3$ induced by an automorphism of the pair $(X_3, S_3)$? Equivalently, does the natural inclusion
$$\mathrm{Aut}(X_3, S_3) \hookrightarrow \mathrm{Aut}(V_3)$$
yield an equality $\mathrm{Aut}(V_3) = \mathrm{Aut}(X_3, S_3)$? In particular, is $\mathrm{Aut}(V_3)$ a finite group?
artifact.status_search_result: A web search did not return any publication explicitly resolving the question of whether every automorphism of the affine cubic hypersurface $V_3 = X_3 \setminus S_3$ extends to an automorphism of the pair $(X_3, S_3)$, nor establishing finiteness of $\mathrm{Aut}(V_3)$. Related work by Dubouloz–Moser-Jauslin treats automorphism groups of certain rational hypersurfaces in $\mathbb{C}^4$ (such as Koras–Russell threefolds), but the smooth cubic case stated here does not appear to have a known resolution.

status_evidence.title: Automorphism Groups of Certain Rational Hypersurfaces in Complex Four-Space
status_evidence.snippet: Dubouloz and Moser-Jauslin study automorphism groups of rational hypersurfaces in C^4, including extension of automorphisms to ambient space, but for Koras-Russell type rather than smooth cubic complements.
status_evidence.claim: Closely related results exist but do not resolve the specific question for smooth cubic hypersurfaces and their hyperplane-section complements.

status_evidence.claim: No listed publication explicitly establishes Aut(V_3) = Aut(X_3, S_3) or finiteness of Aut(V_3) for smooth cubic hypersurfaces in P^4.
